intro: Luxembourg is a constitutional monarchy, the only grand duchy in the world, and home to several EU institutions.

chapters.title: Grand duke and parliament
text: The grand duke is head of state, and the 60-member Chamber of Deputies chooses the government. Luxembourg uses the euro.

chapters.title: Heart of Europe
text: Luxembourg hosts the EU's Court of Justice and its investment bank. Its motto is 'We want to remain what we are'.
